# Otta

> Otta is the self-learning software factory for autonomous coding agents. It is
> GitHub-native: it installs as a GitHub App, orchestrates execution agents (such
> as Claude Code and Codex) in isolated git worktrees, and enforces merge-blocking
> quality gates inside your existing pull-request workflow.

## Key pages
- [Otta home](https://otta.build/): What Otta is, the pipeline, and pricing.
- [GitHub-native alternative to Devin](https://otta.build/github-native-alternative-to-devin/): How Otta differs from cloud-hosted autonomous coding agents — GitHub-App-first governance, merge-blocking gates, self-hostable on your own infra.

## Positioning
- GitHub-App-first governance: agents cannot self-approve or bypass repository rules.
- Persistent session memory and a git-canonical brain for continuous self-learning.
- Self-hostable on your own infrastructure on every tier.
